html:
The skills of a skill tree as a tidy grid of and PassiveLink: unknown tree "". Everything comes from Module:Skilltree/data, so the page only says which tree and which part.

Usage 

=== Combat skills ===
{{TreeSkills|Sorcery|combat}}

=== Passive skills ===
{{TreeSkills|Sorcery|passives}}

=== Abyssal skills ===
{{TreeSkills|Sorcery|abyssal}}
  • combat shows the 12 combat skills.
  • passives shows the passives, each with the number of points needed in the tree.
  • abyssal shows the Abyssal skills and the Abyssal passive. It shows nothing while a tree has none stored.

The combat skills, the passives or the Abyssal skills of a skill tree, as a grid of skill links with tooltips.
